extractor.candidate_rule: Incomplete or ambiguous output is a candidate with reasons, never a verified event. A document whose facts live only in an unharvested PDF attachment yields a candidate, not silence. Candidate status never grants a TP (see docs/top30-scoring.md).
extractor.document_revision: clipped-body-sha256:<sha256 of the retained clipped body> — labelled as such; NEVER presented as a full-document hash.
extractor.event_granularity_limit: CURRENT IMPLEMENTATION LIMIT, recorded not defined away: at most one event per trigger type per document (dividend / earnings / board-decision dispatch, scripts/disclosure_events.py:701-714). A document carrying two eligible facts of the same type (e.g. two dividends) yields one event; the second fact is out of scope for this extractor revision and must be counted as a known limit in the per-cell report, never silently treated as absent gold.
extractor.source_document_id: egx:<NewsID> (scripts/disclosure_events.py _doc_id); harvest and sweep copies of one disclosure share one id.

harvest.collection_target: 100% archived collection of the enumerated expected documents; missing records are named failures, not exclusions.
harvest.item_cap_source: worker/egx_harvest.py:271 (stops at 25 items). A cap hit cannot pass 100% collection — stage 2 must implement evidenced pagination/date partitions.
harvest.stage: Stage 1 is spec + fixtures only. NO live EGX collection, NO gold adjudication, NO enumeration runs were performed for this manifest.
harvest.window_source: worker/egx_harvest.py:144 (default 45 days), rolling from today (:150-151) — NOT a fixed historical interval; stage 2 must pass explicit from/to (the source query already accepts from/to/ISIN, :206-208 per design comment).

quarter.basis: announced date as derived by the extractor (standalone date line in the body), not the harvester's item date — see docs/disclosure-events.md finding 2 (iso_date bug).

date_eligibility.basis: source-adjudicated announced date — the date as adjudicated against the EGX source document (header/body), not the extractor's derived announced date. Supersedes the extractor-derived basis above for eligibility decisions.
date_eligibility.rule: a source document is in-quarter when start <= adjudicated announced date <= end (both endpoints inclusive); a document announced exactly on 2026-08-19 or exactly on 2026-11-19 is eligible. Eligibility is frozen from the adjudicated date, never re-derived from extractor output, so an extraction error cannot choose its own recall denominator.
date_eligibility.matches_extractor: scripts/disclosure_events.py marks an event stale when d < QUARTER_START or d > QUARTER_END (both endpoints inclusive) at main 424f4b3

A genuine zero-activity result needs complete source-enumeration evidence — never zero disclosures by default.
